design.lengthMeaning: Serialized material UTF-16 lengths, not tokens.
design.schedule: Original deterministic case order; cyclic variant rotation within each case block; eligible jobs dispatched with dependency-aware bounded concurrency. No outcome-based routing.
design.guidePolicyTimeUnchanged: The synthetic trustedContext assessmentTime stays fixed; wall-clock time does not replace fixture authorization time.
design.modelMethod: Retain jev-latest for byte-identical rich control; halt on any returned version other than jev-1.13.0.
design.codeMapperScope: Experimental six-feature closed schema; no evaluated-payload decoding; no gold labels or fixture IDs passed to mapper.

variantDefinitions.title: Rich baseline — unchanged
variantDefinitions.change: None: exact original serialized request body.

variantDefinitions.title: Rich minus recognition self-question lists
variantDefinitions.change: Delete only the 11 Recognition questions bullet blocks in section 4.

variantDefinitions.title: Trimmed rich minus unrequested reason table
variantDefinitions.change: From rich_trim_questions, delete only the section 10 reason table; retain surrounding text.

variantDefinitions.title: Boundary-preserving shorter guide
variantDefinitions.change: Keep exact rich sections 1, 2 (including 2.1/2.2), 3, 5 and 6. Restate the other sections using existing compact wording; omit unrequested taxonomy.

variantDefinitions.title: Rich + contrastive demonstrations
variantDefinitions.change: Add the frozen demonstration corpus and a question instruction binding to it. Deliberately larger reference condition.

variantDefinitions.title: Shorter boundary core + demonstrations
variantDefinitions.change: Same demonstrations and binding as rich_fewshot; shorter guide.

variantDefinitions.title: Previous compact guide — unchanged
variantDefinitions.change: Change only classifierGuide to the exact previously tested compact object.

variantDefinitions.title: Compact + original contract section
variantDefinitions.change: Replace only compact section 5 with the original rich section 5 text.

variantDefinitions.title: Compact + original attempt/quotation and integrity sections
variantDefinitions.change: Replace compact sections 3 and 6 with their exact rich text. This is a semantic block, not a single-sentence attribution.

variantDefinitions.title: Compact + both boundary restorations
variantDefinitions.change: Restore sections 3, 5, 6 together; factorial complement to the two individual semantic-block restorations.

variantDefinitions.title: Compact array in prior wire order
variantDefinitions.change: Represent the same key/value sections as an ordered array, preserving the original JavaScript wire order.

variantDefinitions.title: Compact array in intended section order
variantDefinitions.change: Reorder only the identical array entries: version, 1, 2.1, 3 ... 11. Compare to compact_array_wire to isolate array entry order.

variantDefinitions.title: Semantic features, without demonstrations
variantDefinitions.change: Replace broad classification/integrity questions with six narrow Choices. Retain the other five native auxiliary questions verbatim.

variantDefinitions.title: Semantic features + demonstrations
variantDefinitions.change: Same feature request plus the frozen demonstrations.

variantDefinitions.title: Small Jev mapper from features_plain
variantDefinitions.change: Second call over only six selected feature labels, deterministic host facts and mapping rules. No raw material, final code verdict, fixture annotations or probabilities.

variantDefinitions.title: Small Jev mapper from features_fewshot
variantDefinitions.change: Identical downstream mapper over the few-shot first-stage outputs; shares those outputs with its code comparator.

planning.forecastMethod: For first stages, scale each historical rich request token count by total serialized byte ratio. Assume 2000 tokens for each tiny second stage. Rough planning only; not a tokenizer or invoice.
planning.reservationMethod: Existing convention: one token per request UTF-8 byte plus 256 overhead. Dynamic mapper <=12000 bytes. Reservations are per in-flight/unresolved request, not all paid at once.
planning.priceEvidence: TypeSafe Models documentation checked September 18, 2026; same frozen prices as existing restart ledger.
planning.budgetCaveat: $0.75 bundle and $3 shared envelopes govern local known charges plus held reservations. Provider-billed usage may differ; a reservation breach halts dispatch.

limitations: Sixteen authored scenarios at three dependent lengths; 48 requests per condition, not 48 independent or held-out scenarios.
One live observation per condition/case. Interleaving reduces timing confounding but does not estimate repeatability or establish a production security rate.
Known development failures informed these variants and new demonstrations. Novel demonstration wording does not make these test families held out.
The three attack-labeled OUTPUT PASS acrostic cases remain disputed: excluded from primary metrics, present in raw/sensitivity outputs.
An abstention is not a detected attack. Unavailable/invalid responses are separate from model misses and never silently counted as successes.
Only the two array variants isolate entry order. Object-to-array changes representation. Boundary-core is a combined restatement, not a single-clause ablation.
Semantic intermediate outputs are fallible model choices; host facts are separate. Agreement or enforced consistency does not establish correctness.
Code and small-Jev conditions share first-stage responses. Auxiliary Noul/policy/contract/Score outputs are inherited from that stage, not re-evaluated by the mapper.
Code does not decode evaluation inputs. Demonstration encodings are prepared offline. No candidate plaintext or expected test label enters live inference.
Tokens reported by the provider are used with frozen list prices. Byte-based reservations and historical token forecasts are planning conventions, not provider billing guarantees.
Classifier Score is descriptive without an accuracy label; confidence is not an established probability of correctness.
